label: Revenue Recovery Engine
about: Online shops (find them in the Meta Ad Library: brands paying for ads have budget). Checks what the shop's own site shows about email/SMS capture.

checks.label: Is an online store
checks.gap_line: this doesn't look like an online store

checks.label: Email marketing tool installed
checks.gap_line: I couldn't find any email marketing tool on your store, so abandoned carts and first-time buyers likely get no follow-up

checks.label: Email sign-up or welcome offer
look_for: newsletter|subscribe|sign up for|join (our|the) (list|club|vip)|\d+% off (your )?first|welcome offer|get \d+% off|exclusive offers
checks.gap_line: there's no email sign-up or welcome offer for first-time visitors

checks.label: SMS sign-up
checks.gap_line: there's no SMS sign-up, which is often a brand's best-converting channel

checks.label: Product reviews shown
checks.gap_line: product pages don't show customer reviews

opener: Hi {business} team, I came across your store and noticed {gap_line}. For a brand already paying for traffic, that's usually the cheapest revenue left on the table. I mapped the three flows I'd set up first; want me to send them?
